prompt: An operator runs the availability check below against a database whose status field reads recovery. What comes back?
explanation: A database in recovery status is not available: recovery mode means the cluster is still rebuilding it from persistence files, so its primary shards are not serving. The availability probe answers with an error status code plus a JSON body carrying error_code and description. Availability also does not guarantee data availability — serving traffic and trusting the data are different questions.

options.text: An error status code with a JSON body containing error_code and description
200 OK, because the endpoint's listener port is still bound
404, because databases in recovery have no REST API object
200 OK with a warning field, because recovery pauses writes but keeps reads serving
